en.description:
HelloPrint is mid-transformation. The entire platform is being rebuilt from the ground up: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine. Everything agent-ready. We ship in a week what used to take a year. What we do not yet have is someone who owns the reliability of all of it: the SLOs, the cost, the AI runtime, and the guardrails that let product engineers move fast without breaking things. That is this role.

Core Objective: Take full technical ownership of production reliability, distributed observability, deployment safety, cost optimization, and AI runtime infrastructure across high-velocity microservices and cloud workloads.


What you will do:

  • SLOs & Error Budgets: Define, track, and enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error-budget policies across core customer journeys and critical services (including checkout, payments, catalog pipelines, and routing engines).

  • Distributed Observability & Telemetry: Expand Telemetry, Sentry + Google Cloud Monitoring distributed tracing, and automated diagnostic tooling across microservices, Laravel Horizon queue workers on Redis, and Google Cloud infrastructure.

  • Deployment Safety & Progressive Delivery: Partner with product teams to evolve CI/CD pipelines with canary traffic shifting, automated SLO-driven rollbacks, and automated health gates in GitHub Actions.

  • AI Platform Operations & FinOps: Architect, monitor, and scale the runtime infrastructure supporting AI agents, semantic pipelines, and background automation. Take full ownership of runtime cost control, model and token budget tracking, latency profiles, rate limits, queue backpressure, and provider availability.

  • Cloud Infrastructure Cost & Budget Optimization: Partner with engineering leadership to drive continuous FinOps practices across Google Cloud workloads, actively identifying resource inefficiencies, optimizing compute/storage footprint, and enforcing infrastructure budget guardrails.

  • Incident Management & Post-Mortems: Lead on-call incident response and blameless post-mortems, systematically turning root causes into automated tests, synthetic checks, and architectural guardrails.

  • Resilience, Capacity & DR: Drive capacity forecasting, dependency isolation, automated load testing, and disaster recovery validations against strict RTO/RPO targets.

  • Infrastructure as Code & Security: Own declarative infrastructure workflows using Terraform and Google Cloud Run, ensuring strict IAM least privilege, Secret Manager, and deterministic environments.

  • Toil Elimination & DevEx: Build pragmatic internal tooling, runbooks, and self-service deployment primitives that eliminate firefighting and enable product engineers to ship reliably.

What we are looking for:

  • Production SRE & Platform Background: Proven experience operating and scaling high-traffic distributed production systems where uptime, low latency, and safe release cycles are paramount.

  • Deep Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux environments, containerized runtimes, relational/NoSQL databases, Redis queues, and cloud network boundaries.

  • GCP & Serverless Container Stacks: Extensive hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, Google Cloud Run, and infrastructure automation via Terraform.

  • Cost Governance & FinOps Mindset: Demonstrated ability to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud and AI runtime costs, striking the right balance between performance, reliability, and budgetary efficiency.

  • Targeted Monitoring & Tracing: Practical experience configuring Sentry (for error reporting and distributed tracing across Laravel and Astro frontends) alongside Google Cloud Monitoring for SLI tracking and canary gates.

  • Automation & Scripting Skills: Proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript for platform tooling, combined with practical working familiarity with modern PHP in a Laravel ecosystem.

  • AI Operations Affinity: Familiarity with operationalizing LLM integrations, embeddings/vector workflows, rate-limited external APIs, or background task orchestration.

  • Engineering Mindset: Pragmatic builder with high technical agency who values durable system guardrails and deterministic automation over manual interventions.

offers.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
offers.requirements:
What Success Looks Like After 12 Months

  • Critical Journey Protection: 100% of primary commerce flows are guarded by automated E2E tests in CI.

  • Fast & Stable Pipelines: CI test suite execution completes in under 10 minutes with a test flakiness rate below 1%.

  • Defect Shift: At least 80% of functional regression issues are caught in automated CI runs before reaching staging or production.

  • Compounding Resilience: Every resolved high-priority incident has an associated regression test in the repository, making the harness the living memory of the platform.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years of software testing and automation experience as an SDET or QA Automation Engineer working with modern web applications and distributed APIs.

  • Practical AI Perspective: A sharp, realistic perspective on how AI tools impact modern software engineering—understanding why accelerated code generation elevates the need for deterministic test suites, strict interface contracts, and fast feedback loops.

  • Core Tooling: Hands-on experience building robust, flake-free automated test suites in TypeScript / JavaScript using Playwright (or Cypress), alongside API testing frameworks.

  • API & Contract Testing: Practical experience validating RESTful APIs, webhooks, and JSON data contracts across microservices.

  • CI/CD Practicality: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions (or equivalent CI systems), with an emphasis on parallel test runners, containerized test execution, and pipeline debugging.

  • Mindset: AI-first thinking, high autonomy and ownership, and office-first commitment in Rotterdam HQ.


We encourage applications even if you do not meet 100% of the listed points. Relevant practical experience and problem-solving skills matter most.

This role is not for you if you

  • See QA as the step that happens after the "real" work;

  • Want a fixed checklist and no ownership of strategy;

  • Got into automation because it was on a job spec, not because manual repetition genuinely bothers you;

  • Need heavy process to move;

  • Would rather work from home than sit next to the team you are gatekeeping for.

What we offer

  • 🎯 Room to grow: opportunities develop fast, within your role and across HelloPrint

  • 🌍 The team: 100+ people from 20+ nationalities who build at a pace most companies cannot match. Rotterdam is not a compromise. It is where the work happens.

  • 🚀 Real impact: shape the future of a high-growth, AI-driven company where your ideas land in production the same week.

  • 💡 Full autonomy from day one: no roadmap to follow, no brief to wait for. You see the problem, you build the solution, you own the outcome.

  • 🏃🏻‍♂️‍➡️ Hello-Benefits: including 24/7 HelloFit gym access, UrbanSportsClub discount, the best events and company-sponsored healthy meals every day

  • 💶 Base salary: 4500-6000 gross per month, depending on seniority and experience

At HelloPrint, we believe diversity makes us better. We're building a workplace where everyone can be themselves, grow, and do their best work regardless of background, identity, or perspective. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

offers.sharing_description: Own quality across 14 markets. Build test automation, integrate QA into CI/CD, and ship fast without breaking production. On-site QA Engineer role in Rotterdam. Apply now.

en.description:
HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We are rebuilding the platform: ecommerce, APIs, internal tooling, all under active development at speed. Speed without quality is just faster breakage. This role exists to make fast releases safe, and to turn QA from a bottleneck into leverage.

About the Role

At HelloPrint, our engineering teams are accelerating development cycles using autonomous and AI-assisted tooling. While AI makes generating code exponentially faster and cheaper, verifying that core business workflows and transaction guarantees remain intact stays just as complex. Without a rock-solid testing harness, higher code velocity simply translates to higher operational risk.

We are looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of our automated Platform Test Harness. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain the end-to-end and contract-testing architecture that enables our teams to develop with AI fearlessly, safeguarding our core customer and commerce flows under continuous delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Architect the Platform Test Harness for AI Velocity: Design, implement, and maintain deterministic E2E test suites using Playwright and TypeScript. Build the automated guardrails required to safely absorb high-frequency, AI-assisted code generation without regression.

  • Implement Contract Testing & Boundary Validation: Establish strict API schema validations and contract tests (REST / JSON Schema) at service boundaries to prevent schema drift between our Product Catalog Engine, checkout services, and partner integrations.

  • Shift-Left Quality in AI Workflows: Partner with Product Owners and software engineers during sprint refinement to define explicit boundary contracts and edge cases upfront—embedding a clear Definition of Done before feature code or AI prompts are executed.

  • High-Speed CI/CD Orchestration: Maintain and optimize GitHub Actions test pipelines, focusing on smart test parallelization, artifact caching, and keeping feedback loops under 10 minutes.

  • Accumulate Platform Memory: Partner with engineering during post-incident reviews to ensure every confirmed production defect results in an automated test that makes that specific failure path impossible to repeat silently.

  • Collaborate & Mentor: Pair with our QA Automation Engineer and mentor software engineers in writing effective integration tests, adopting TDD habits, and reviewing AI-generated test scaffolding.

offers.description:
HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We are rebuilding the platform: ecommerce, APIs, internal tooling, all under active development at speed. Speed without quality is just faster breakage. This role exists to make fast releases safe, and to turn QA from a bottleneck into leverage.

About the Role

At HelloPrint, our engineering teams are accelerating development cycles using autonomous and AI-assisted tooling. While AI makes generating code exponentially faster and cheaper, verifying that core business workflows and transaction guarantees remain intact stays just as complex. Without a rock-solid testing harness, higher code velocity simply translates to higher operational risk.

We are looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of our automated Platform Test Harness. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain the end-to-end and contract-testing architecture that enables our teams to develop with AI fearlessly, safeguarding our core customer and commerce flows under continuous delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Architect the Platform Test Harness for AI Velocity: Design, implement, and maintain deterministic E2E test suites using Playwright and TypeScript. Build the automated guardrails required to safely absorb high-frequency, AI-assisted code generation without regression.

  • Implement Contract Testing & Boundary Validation: Establish strict API schema validations and contract tests (REST / JSON Schema) at service boundaries to prevent schema drift between our Product Catalog Engine, checkout services, and partner integrations.

  • Shift-Left Quality in AI Workflows: Partner with Product Owners and software engineers during sprint refinement to define explicit boundary contracts and edge cases upfront—embedding a clear Definition of Done before feature code or AI prompts are executed.

  • High-Speed CI/CD Orchestration: Maintain and optimize GitHub Actions test pipelines, focusing on smart test parallelization, artifact caching, and keeping feedback loops under 10 minutes.

  • Accumulate Platform Memory: Partner with engineering during post-incident reviews to ensure every confirmed production defect results in an automated test that makes that specific failure path impossible to repeat silently.

  • Collaborate & Mentor: Pair with our QA Automation Engineer and mentor software engineers in writing effective integration tests, adopting TDD habits, and reviewing AI-generated test scaffolding.

offers.title: Senior AI Engineer
offers.requirements:
This role is not for people who got into AI because it became important. It is for people who have been building since before anyone called it a career. The kind of person who coded as a teenager, shipped their first thing before anyone asked, and has never really stopped. Who finds it genuinely difficult to explain why they build: it is just what they do. Who would rather spend a Sunday solving a hard systems problem than almost anything else. If you have to think about whether that description fits you, it probably does not.

This role will resonate with a specific kind of person. You will recognise yourself in one of these profiles:

  • You are a strong engineer inside a startup or scale-up, shipping real features and systems, but three or four layers removed from the business decisions your work actually drives. You want to be closer to the number your code moves, not further away from it.

  • Or you are building on your own: side projects, freelance work, an AI SaaS or open-source tool nobody asked you to build. You've proven you can ship alone, but you're doing it without the customer base, the data, or the stability to make it count at scale. HelloPrint gives you 600,000 customers to build on immediately.

  • Or you are early in your career but not in your building. You've been writing code since before it paid you to, you've got real production work behind you already, and you're looking for the place that lets that intensity be the job instead of something you do around it.

What you will build:

The opportunity surface is large: 14 markets, 600,000 customers, a platform being rebuilt in parallel across four core engines. You'll work on problems from areas like:

  • Dynamic pricing and margin optimization across markets.

  • Agentic procurement: supplier selection, ordering, quality management.

  • Customer journey automation from configuration to post-delivery.

  • Intelligent content and SEO infrastructure at platform scale.

  • Predictive demand and inventory across the supplier network.

  • Internal tooling that multiplies the output of every team.

Who you are:

You've built and shipped real production systems, not just contributed to someone else's. You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't need a fully specified brief to start. You care about what your work is worth, not just whether it works. You want to build inside a company that's already proven, not another 0-to-1 bet. You do not think of yourself as an AI engineer. You think of yourself as someone who solves hard problems and builds the systems to prove it. The engineering is the method. The obsession is the identity.

Three signals that tell us you are that person:

  • You've spotted an opportunity for an AI solution before anyone assigned it to you, and built it, even if it started as a side project or a shortcut nobody asked for. Ask you to name one and it won't take you long.

  • What you've shipped has been in production and actually used, not a prototype sitting in a repo or a demo that impressed someone once.

  • You can point to at least one thing you built where you had a rough idea of what it was worth before building it, and checked afterward whether it delivered.

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on production experience, not purely architectural or supervisory.

  • Commercial instinct that precedes technical execution: you know the business case before you write the first line.

  • Track record of shipping production AI/software systems that are live and used by real users.

  • Solid fluency in LLMs, agentic workflows, and modern AI infrastructure.

  • Ability to reason about commercial impact, not just technical correctness.

  • Comfortable working with high autonomy and limited process.

  • Office-first: on-site in Rotterdam, five days a week.

This role is not for you if you:

  • Got into AI because it became an important skill, not because you could not imagine doing anything else.

  • Need a brief, a PM, or a defined scope before taking action.

  • Measure your output in technical quality or feature count rather than business impact.

  • Would answer 'what would you build first?' with an infrastructure question.

  • If you think a workweek of 40h is a lot.

  • Prefer hybrid or remote working.

  • 🌍 The team: 100+ people from 20+ nationalities who build at a pace most companies cannot match. Rotterdam is not a compromise. It is where the work happens.

  • 🚀 Real impact: shape the future of a high-growth, AI-driven company where your ideas land in production the same week.

  • 💡 Full autonomy from day one: no roadmap to follow, no brief to wait for. You see the problem, you build the solution, you own the outcome.

  • 🏃🏻‍♂️‍➡️ Hello-Benefits: including 24/7 HelloFit gym access, UrbanSportsClub discount, the best events and company-sponsored healthy meals every day

  • 💶 Base salary: €80,000 to €140,000 gross per year, depending on seniority and experience.

offers.title: Open Application
offers.requirements:
What we’re looking for..

We’re looking for people who are clearly ahead of the curve: the kind of people who apply before there’s a job opening.

Usually, that means you:

  • Use AI as a default, not an add-on

  • Think in outcomes, not tasks

  • Figure things out without waiting for direction

  • Move fast, even when things aren’t fully defined

  • Want to build, not maintain

If you need structure to get started, this probably isn’t it. If you see that as an opportunity, we should talk.

How we work..

We’re fully office-first, based in Rotterdam and Valencia. Not because we don’t trust remote work, but because we believe speed, energy, and real collaboration happen when people are in the same room. That’s how we operate. It works for us.

What to include in your application..

Don’t send us a generic motivation letter. Tell us:

  • What you’re exceptionally good at

  • Why HelloPrint, specifically

  • What you would build, fix, or improve here and how.
